_comment: Schema for custom-places.json. Copy this file to custom-places.json (same directory) and fill in real coordinates. The real file is gitignored.

home._comment: Center of your home metro. POIs farther than metro_radius_km get a 'City, ST' (or 'City, Country') caption suffix. Defaults to the 'Home' place if omitted.

places.name: Universal Studios Orlando
places._comment: Context-mode example: large venue with sub-POIs (rides, areas). Resolver drills deeper inside the bubble instead of returning 'Universal Studios Orlando' directly.
